title: Pure Hazy Flame
summary: Hazy Flame cards with a small Fire King and Fire Formation package and Rank 6 Xyz bosses. Every Hazy Flame monster is a Level 6 FIRE monster that cannot be targeted by the opponent's card effects, and four of them have 200 DEF for Rekindling.

summary.title: Starters
points: Hazy Flame Cerbereus can be Normal Summoned without Tributing at 1000 original ATK, and searches any Hazy card when destroyed and sent to the GY.
Hazy Pillar and Hazy Glory let you Normal Summon Level 6 Hazy Flame monsters for 1 less Tribute (0 Tributes).
Hazy Flame Peryton sends 1 FIRE monster from the hand to the GY and Tributes itself to Special Summon 2 Hazy Flame monsters directly from the Deck.
Fire Formation - Tenki searches Fire King Avatar Arvata, which destroys Hazy Flame Cerbereus in the hand or field to negate a monster effect and trigger Cerbereus's search.

summary.title: Opening: Hazy Pillar + Hazy Flame Peryton + FIRE Monster
steps: Activate Hazy Pillar to Normal Summon Hazy Flame Peryton without Tributing.
Send a FIRE monster from your hand to the GY and Tribute Peryton to Special Summon Hazy Flame Sphynx and Hazy Flame Hydra from the Deck.
Use Hazy Flame Sphynx to call the top card type of your Deck, mill 1 card, and revive Hazy Flame Peryton or another FIRE monster from the GY.

Overlay Hydra, Sphynx, and your third Level 6 into Hazy Flame Basiltrice; Hydra attaches an extra Hazy Flame from the GY as material, and Hazy Pillar attaches another from the hand or field to reach 5 materials.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Hazy Flame Basiltrice can be Xyz Summoned with 2 to 5 Level 6 FIRE monsters: it detaches 1 material to banish a monster from the opponent's field or GY, gains 200 ATK/DEF per material at 3+, cannot be targeted at 4+, and cannot be destroyed by card effects at 5 materials.
Evolzar Lars detaches 1 material to negate any face-up card the opponent controls, and Evolzar Solda cannot be destroyed by card effects while it has material and destroys Special Summoned monsters.
Bujinki Ahashima summons two Level 6 Hazy Flames (one from hand, one from GY) to immediately assemble a Rank 6 Xyz.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Rekindling Special Summons as many FIRE monsters with 200 DEF as possible from your GY—reviving Hazy Flame Peryton, Cerbereus, Griffin, Mantikor, and Fire King Avatar Arvata all at once.
Onslaught of the Fire Kings Special Summons Hazy Flame Cerbereus from the Deck and destroys it during the End Phase to search Hazy Pillar or Hazy Glory.
Hazy Glory reduces Tribute requirements while face-up and sends itself from the field to the GY to recover any Hazy card from the GY.

allow.Rekindling: Special Summons as many FIRE monsters with 200 DEF as possible from your GY—and Hazy Flame Cerbereus, Hazy Flame Peryton, Hazy Flame Griffin, and Hazy Flame Mantikor ALL have exactly 200 DEF!
allow.Fire King Avatar Arvata: Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warrior with 200 DEF that negates monster effects by destroying Hazy Flame Cerbereus in your hand or field (immediately triggering Cerbereus to search Hazy Pillar or Sphynx!).
allow.Onslaught of the Fire Kings: Special Summons a Level 6 FIRE Beast/Beast-Warrior/Winged Beast Hazy Flame (Sphynx, Cerbereus, Griffin, or Mantikor) from the Deck and destroys it during the End Phase (triggering Cerbereus!).
allow.Fire Formation - Tenki: Continuous Spell that searches Level 4 Fire King Avatar Arvata on activation, while granting a passive 100 ATK boost to all Beast-Warriors.
allow.Evolzar Lars: Rank 6 FIRE Dragon Xyz summonable using any two Level 6 FIRE Hazy Flame monsters that detaches 1 material to negate any face-up card the opponent controls.
allow.Bujinki Ahashima: Link-2 monster that summons 2 Level 6 Hazy Flames (1 from hand, 1 from GY) to immediately Xyz Summon Hazy Flame Basiltrice or Evolzar Lars.

main: Hazy Flame Peryton

Core Level 6 FIRE Pyro (200 DEF for Rekindling!): cannot be targeted by opponent's effects; sends 1 FIRE monster from your hand to the GY and tributes itself to Special Summon 2 'Hazy Flame' monsters directly from your Deck!
Hazy Flame Sphynx

Core Level 6 FIRE Beast-Warrior: cannot be targeted by opponent's effects; declares the top card type of your Deck (Monster/Spell/Trap) to mill 1 card, and if correct, Special Summons 1 FIRE monster from your hand or GY!
Hazy Flame Cerbereus

Level 6 FIRE Beast (2000 ATK / 200 DEF for Rekindling!): can be Normal Summoned without Tributing (as 1000 ATK), cannot be targeted by opponent's effects, and searches ANY 'Hazy' card (including Hazy Pillar!) when destroyed and sent to the GY.
Hazy Flame Griffin

Level 6 FIRE Winged Beast (200 DEF for Rekindling!): Special Summons itself from your hand in Defense Position if your opponent controls a monster and all monsters in your field/GY are FIRE, and cannot be targeted by opponent's effects.
Hazy Flame Hydra

Level 6 FIRE Dinosaur: cannot be targeted by opponent's effects; an Xyz Monster summoned using Hydra as material (Hazy Flame Basiltrice!) attaches 1 additional Hazy Flame monster from your GY as Xyz Material—helping Basiltrice instantly reach 5 materials!
Hazy Flame Mantikor
Level 6 FIRE Winged Beast (2200 ATK / 200 DEF for Rekindling!): sends 1 other FIRE monster from hand/field to GY as a Quick Effect to make itself indestructible by card effects this turn.
Fire King Avatar Arvata
200 DEF FIRE monster that negates any monster effect by destroying Hazy Flame Cerbereus in your hand or field, immediately triggering Cerbereus to search Hazy Pillar or Peryton!
Hazy Pillar

Core Continuous Spell: lets you Normal Summon 'Hazy Flame' monsters for 1 less Tribute (0 Tributes for Level 6s!), and once per turn attaches 1 Hazy Flame monster from your hand or field to a Hazy Flame Basiltrice you control!
Rekindling
Revives up to 5 copies of Hazy Flame Peryton, Cerbereus, Griffin, Mantikor, and Arvata (all 200 DEF FIRE!) from your GY for a massive 5-material Hazy Flame Basiltrice + Evolzar Lars board!
Onslaught of the Fire Kings
Special Summons Hazy Flame Cerbereus from the Deck and destroys it during the End Phase to search Hazy Pillar.
Fire Formation - Tenki
Searches Level 4 Fire King Avatar Arvata on activation.
Hazy Glory
Continuous Trap: lets you Normal Summon Hazy Flame monsters for 1 less Tribute, and sends itself from the field to the GY to recover 1 'Hazy' card from your GY to your hand.
extra: Signature Rank 6 FIRE Pyro Xyz boss (2 or more [max. 5] Level 6 FIRE monsters): detaches 1 material to banish 1 monster your opponent controls or in their GY; gains +200 ATK/DEF per material (3+ materials), cannot be targeted by card effects (4+ materials), and cannot be destroyed by card effects (5 materials)!
Rank 6 FIRE Dragon Xyz that detaches 1 material to negate the effects of any face-up card your opponent controls.
Link-2 monster that summons 1 Level 6 Hazy Flame from hand and 1 from GY to immediately Xyz Summon Hazy Flame Basiltrice.
Rank 6: cannot be destroyed by card effects while having materials; detaches 1 material to destroy an opponent's Special Summoned monster.
